title: Console access review & audit UX: prototypes for org/workspace RBAC and audit flows
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype the end-to-end access review and audit experience in the Redwood Console. This ticket covers org and workspace settings pages (role management and permission matrix), an access-review scheduler and run flow for periodic certification, and a redesigned audit log view (filtering, aggregation, export). The goal is to produce hi-fi Figma frames and a reviewable spec for engineering handoff, with clear interaction patterns for large orgs and GDPR-conscious export/retention behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi Figma prototype covering: org-level roles editor, workspace-level role previews, permission matrix with resource-based filters, access-review creation and run screen, and audit log list/detail with advanced filters and CSV export
Design spec includes accessibility requirements (WCAG 2.1 AA), performance notes (table virtualization for >100k events), and responsive behavior for narrow consoles
PM and Security feedback addressed; at least one round of engineering feasibility review completed and action items documented
Handoff artifact created: design tokens, component variants, interaction notes, and a prioritized implementation backlog
comments: 2026-02-26 Maya Chen: Initial discovery complete. Meta-research: looked at Okta, OneLogin, AWS Console, and Google Workspace for access review metaphors. Shortlist patterns: matrix-led edits, stepper-run for certifications, and event-centric audit timeline.

2026-03-01 Sofia Martinez: Low-fi wireframes uploaded to Figma. Key decision: show role inheritance in the matrix as collapsible rows rather than separate modal (reduces modal complexity in large orgs). Need engineering feedback on query surface for combined filters (actor + resource + action).

2026-03-03 Liam O'Connor (eng): Feasibility review notes: backend can provide combined filters but we should avoid N+1 calls for role previews. Recommendation: add an endpoint for batched role resolution and a cache TTL. Marked as dependency ENG-2387.

2026-03-05 Maya Chen: Prototype updated with run-history microcopy and CSV export CTA. Trade-offs documented: we can include redaction toggle for export, but this requires additional audit permissions. Flagging for Security review.

2026-03-07 Priya Desai (PM): Reviewed flows. Suggested adding a lightweight onboarding tour when admins visit Access Reviews for the first time and an ability to assign remediation tasks directly from a review run. Added to wishlist but deprioritized for MVP.

2026-03-09 Security review (notes): Export retention and data minimization approved conditional on KMS integration audit log. Security asks for an explicit consent banner and export justification field included in the run record. Update spec accordingly.

2026-03-11 Engineering sync: Agreed on component contract for Permission Matrix. Eng will implement virtualized table and provide a feature flag. Backend dependency list: ENG-2387 (role resolution), ENG-2410 (audit search API), ENG-2435 (export job).
2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Addressed comments and pushed hi-fi frames with interaction states. Ready for final design review meeting on 2026-03-15. Handoff checklist created and linked in attachments.
notes: Key UX risks: information density for large orgs, permission vocabulary differences across customers, and avoiding accidental privilege escalation when editing role bindings. Proposed mitigations: contextual inline help, confirm dialogs for high-risk changes, and a preview sandbox that shows effective permissions before committing changes. Also include telemetry hooks for adoption metrics.
